note: Kept by hand. What the next versions bring, read by scripts/tv-list.py. The first item whose match fits a TV is used. match: brands (brand or maker), devices, profiles (tested list names), sdk, blocks (the release's reason), homes (a Home claimant), r0 (the test build's switch works on it). override: the item wins over a release that gives the new home screen. Drop an item once its version ships.

items.title: XGIMI MoGo 3 Pro
items.what: The switch works, but the projector's remote keys turn Google TV's home screen back on. The Home button helper keeps Home on the new home screen.

items.title: Xiaomi and Redmi TVs on Android 14
items.what: The new home screen with the setup wizard left on, as on Android 9 to 11, now that testers confirmed it on Android 14.

items.title: Chromecast with Google TV and the Google TV Streamer
items.what: The Home button helper: Google TV and its setup wizard stay on underneath, so casting keeps working, and Home opens the new home screen.

items.title: RockTek Google TV boxes
items.what: The Home button helper, which keeps the setup wizard on, so casting keeps working too.

items.title: Google TV sets that keep their home screen because of the setup wizard
items.what: The Home button helper: the TV's own home screen and its setup wizard stay on, and pressing Home takes you to the new home screen.
